description: Three bowls sit on the green tablecloth in front of you: a light purple bowl on the left, a darker teal bowl in the middle, and a light mint-green bowl on the right. The left hand reaches forward to grasp and lift the light purple bowl, carries it rightward, and lowers it onto the darker teal bowl while the right hand steadies the teal bowl as a right-hand object; then the right hand picks up the mint-green bowl and places it on top, forming a stacked set while the left hand supports the stack as a left-hand object.
